ruleDefinitions.name: Remote CHM File Download/Execution Via HH.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the usage of "hh.exe" to execute/download remotely hosted ".chm" files.

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "HH\.exe" OR process_path = RGX("\\\\hh\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*http\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\\\.*")))
